column4: The control asserts that a recorded founder refund decision cannot be updated or deleted. To assert it, the probe must first CREATE one, and public.fn_kernel_refund_decision_record writes decided_by from a verified founder identity resolved by fn_phase_c_require_founder -- never from the call. Since PCCR-006, fn_phase_c_founder_subject_bind refuses every connection that is not the PostgREST one which verified a founder bearer token (pccr_founder_bind_untrusted_connection), so no management or migration connection can produce the row the append-only trigger exists to protect. The trigger itself is deployed, unchanged, and still asserted directly against its own 23514 refusals in scripts/checks/protected_table_guards_actually_fire.test.mjs.
column5: A founder bearer token presented to /rest/v1/rpc through PostgREST, so that fn_phase_c_founder_subject_bind resolves a verified subject and fn_kernel_refund_decision_record can record a real decision for the probe to then fail to edit. Only the founder can produce that token; nothing in this repository can, and PCCR-006 exists to keep it that way.
